import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String line = scanner.next();
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
        boolean atReplaced = false;
        int index = 0;
        while (index < line.length()) {
            if (index > 0 && index < line.length() - 1 && line.charAt(index) == 'a' && line.charAt(index + 1) == 't' && !atReplaced) {
                result.append('@');
                index += 2;
                atReplaced = true;
            } else if (index > 0 && index < line.length() - 2 && line.charAt(index) == 'd' && line.charAt(index + 1) == 'o' && line.charAt(index + 2) == 't') {
                result.append('.');
                index += 3;
            } else {
                result.append(line.charAt(index));
                index++;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(result.toString());
        scanner.close();
    }
}
